newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Moroccan party leader hurt in accident.
newsitem.headline: Moroccan party leader hurt in accident.

text.p: Veteran Moroccan politician Ali Yata, 76, was badly injured in a accident at the weekend when caught between two cars as a third crashed into them.
Yata, secretary-general of the opposition Progress and Socialism Party, underwent surgery on Saturday night, shortly after the accident, his party said on Sunday.
His condition was described as stable.
Yata's party, which has 14 seats in Morocco's 333-seat parliament, is a member of the opposition bloc known as the Koutla.
